node.statement: Let A be the allowable atlas supplied by the antecedent. By node 1.1.1, the domains of the charts in A are open in M and cover M; by node 1.1.3, each such chart domain is the domain of an allowable coordinate system. Hence these allowable-coordinate domains form an open cover of M. Since M is compact, node 1.1.2 selects finitely many systems from this family whose domains still cover M, which is exactly the conclusion of node 1.1.
